questions.question: What occasion is Psalm 18 connected to?
options: The day that David defeated Goliath the great Philistine warrior
The day the LORD delivered David from his enemies and from Saul
The day that David brought the ark of God up into Jerusalem
The day that David was anointed to be king over all of Israel
questions.answer: The day the LORD delivered David from his enemies and from Saul

questions.question: How does David begin this psalm?
options: 'Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good'
'I love you, O LORD, my strength'
'How majestic is your name in all the earth'
'Bless the LORD, O my soul, and all within me'
questions.answer: 'I love you, O LORD, my strength'
